Why create a separate Assignment Constraints table?

Budget, Timeline, and Working Days are business constraints that control the optimization process. Keeping them separate from the Assignment's basic information maintains database normalization and allows the Assignment entity to remain focused on identification and configuration.
Why is this a One-to-One relationship?
Each Assignment can have only one Budget, one Timeline, and one Working Days Per Month value. Therefore, a single Constraint record is sufficient for each Assignment.
Why isn't Optimization Type stored here?

Optimization Type defines the optimization strategy (Cost Minimization or Profit Maximization) and is an attribute of the Assignment itself.
